selection: Existing supervised A epoch9 fixed before this study. No tuning/selection of another model.
ablations: Remove weighted contribution AND associated forced trigger; surviving weights unchanged. First-frame/trajectory resets/hard max_skip4 always retained. No redundant age-only experiment (equals fixed5).
scoring: Every current frame; pooled additive FP64 metric sums; reused prediction unwarped; same GT[.1,1000] mask/near<10; original event p10<8 entry or drop>=2, reset per trajectory. GT never enters decisions; zero-event/censored cases retained.
causal_inputs: Current RGB vs last inferred RGB; held GPS velocity and contemporaneous manifest IMU only. No privileged velocity/GT masks/depth/future samples.
live_risk_cache: Update risk+availability on explicit fresh prediction source token; retain on reuse; reset at trajectory boundaries; age independent. Full cached/uncached reference checks and synthetic threshold boundaries required.

timing.precision: FP32 eval batch1, CPU2 threads, CUDA synchronized; alternate policy/device order
timing.scope: Bounded live timing, 256 frames/run, reset at window start; calls differ from full-trajectory quality. No extrapolated full-run latency claim. OS cache uncontrolled.
timing.boundaries: Separate raw RGB+GT byte I/O, decode/resize, H2D/D2H, synchronized model-only, scheduler including live risk-cache update, end-to-end; GT reads serve validation/display not scheduling. Exclude warmups, offline scoring and final file writes.

known_limits: A pooled AbsRel improves11.84%, nearRMSE worsens16.18% vsoriginal
Teacher gate rejected; KD exploratory negative result preserved
Two familiar validation paths; ablations change inference budgets
No energy/battery/flight-safety or independent test generalization claim
